title: After 'Turn off on this device' the open admin app still chimes and pops up for every new alert
what: Settings says 'Alerts are off for this device' once the owner turns them off, but that only stops the alerts that come with the app closed. While the admin app is open, every new alert still plays the chime and shows a browser notice, because the browser's yes is kept. There is no way to silence the open app short of blocking the site in browser settings.
expected: Off means off on this device: no chime and no notice, open or closed, or the card says plainly that the open app still rings.
how_often: every new alert while the app is open after turning alerts off
fix_line: Let the device switch also silence the open app's sound and notice

title: Choosing 'Once a day' for the rest still rings at once for each question or message while the app is open
what: The owner picks when the rest (questions, messages, feedback, payments, new members, workout reports) come: Instantly, Once a day or Once a week, and once a day is the starting choice. The open admin app ignores that choice and chimes with a notice for each new one straight away.
expected: With Once a day or Once a week, the open app shows the rest quietly in the bell, and rings only for the always-at-once kinds.
how_often: every non-urgent alert while the app is open
fix_line: Ring in the open app only for urgent kinds unless the choice is Instantly

title: The admin app's alert sound stays silent until someone clicks in it after opening
what: The chime is made in the browser each time. A browser keeps that sound switched off until the page has had a click, and the app never asks it to start, so a desk computer left on the admin app after a reload or restart shows the notice but plays no sound, and nothing is logged.
expected: The sound works once alerts are on, or the app shows 'Tap anywhere to allow the sound' until it can play.
how_often: after every reload until the first click
fix_line: Start the sound on the first tap and show a hint until then

title: A browser notice from the open admin app stays on screen after the job in it is done
what: When a request, order or message is handled, the bell and Today mark it done, but the browser notice the open app showed for it is never closed, so it sits in the computer's notice list as if it still needs someone.
expected: Done means gone: the notice for a handled alert closes itself.
fix_line: Close the notice with the same tag when its alert is done

items.reason: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check: admin app on an Android phone (OPPO/Xiaomi/Samsung) with alerts on, screen off and battery saver on: does the closed-app alert show and sound; with the app open on the phone: one notice or two, and does the chime play; iPhone added to Home Screen: does the alert arrive
